name: Bitkey (Block)
upstream_hygiene_defect: Unsigned naked .sha256 text files on APKs; zero detached cryptographic signatures; firmware cloud-tethered via proprietary OTA without standalone binary releases
cure_requirement: Sign release checksums with declared developer PGP/BIP-340 key; publish decoupled, verifiable standalone firmware binaries

name: BlueWallet
upstream_hygiene_defect: App Store lock-in; standalone APKs lack detached cryptographic signatures on GitHub release tags
cure_requirement: Sign raw GitHub APK releases with persistent developer GPG/minisign key and detached signature

name: Foundation Passport
upstream_hygiene_defect: Raw MicroSD .bin firmware updates distributed without detached cryptographic signatures signed by developer key
cure_requirement: Publish signed SHA256SUMS.asc with firmware binaries on public release tags

name: Muun Wallet
upstream_hygiene_defect: Closed mobile distribution; zero standalone verifiable APK or desktop release assets on git tags
cure_requirement: Publish reproducible, open-source APK binaries with signed checksums to git release tags

name: BitBox02 Firmware
upstream_hygiene_defect: Hardware-enforced m-of-n YubiKey/FIDO2 threshold ceremony requiring custom Python quorum validator rather than flat ASCII manifest
cure_requirement: Incorporate native ShiftCrypto threshold quorum parser into BinWatch engine (in-progress backlog)

name: Boltz Client
upstream_hygiene_defect: Modern Minisign (Ed25519) detached signature format; requires Minisign parser and in-tree pubkey anchor specification
cure_requirement: Add native Minisign verification module to BinWatch core auditor

name: Trezor Suite
upstream_hygiene_defect: Multi-tier signing model: desktop Electron client uses OS-level Authenticode/Apple certs + SatoshiLabs GPG, while MCU bootloader enforces on-chip OTP root-of-trust
cure_requirement: Implement dual-pipeline auditor distinguishing desktop Electron binaries from embedded bootloader signatures

name: BTCPay Server
upstream_hygiene_defect: Microservices daemon distributed via Docker Compose and container registries; lacks standalone flat CLI binary tarballs on release tags
cure_requirement: Add OCI container registry digest attestation (Cosign/Sigstore) parser to BinWatch engine

name: LNbits
upstream_hygiene_defect: Web application framework distributed via PyPI / Docker; lacks detached cryptographically signed standalone binary manifests
cure_requirement: Support Python package hash pinning and OCI container digest verification

name: Ledger Live Desktop
upstream_hygiene_defect: Closed-source Secure Element (BOLOS) firmware blobs and non-standard release manifest distribution
cure_requirement: Publish fully open, reproducible build manifests with detached open cryptographic signatures
